Future<void> main() async {

  try {
    final request = await createCreateResponseRequestFromJson(json: '{"input":"What is the weather in San Francisco?","model":"gpt-4o","tools":[{"description":"Get current weather for a location","name":"get_weather","parameters":{"properties":{"location":{"type":"string"}},"required":["location"],"type":"object"},"type":"function"}]}');
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
      final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
    final result = await client.createResponse(req: request);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
